column_description: ID of the type of asset (e.g., 3D Models, Textures, HDRI). may be NULL.
ID of the category of asset (e.g., Installations, Buildings). may be NULL.
ID of the subcategory of asset (e.g., Destroyed, Lamps). may be NULL.
Tags associated with the asset (e.g., cyber, neon, pixel). always exactly one of 'cyber', 'neon', 'pixel'. may be NULL.
File path to the asset. may be NULL.
Class of the asset. may be NULL.
Date and time when the asset was created. may be NULL.
Date and time when the asset was last updated. may be NULL.
Detailed description of the asset. may be NULL.
Status of the asset (e.g., active, archived, draft). always exactly one of 'active', 'archived', 'draft'. may be NULL.
Path to the thumbnail image of the asset. may be NULL.
License information for the asset. may be NULL.
ID of the user who created the asset. may be NULL.
Size of the asset file in bytes. may be NULL.
Resolution of the asset (if applicable, e.g., 1920x1080). may be NULL.
